description_en: Queries all consumer groups of a user or performs a fuzzy query by consumer group name
description_zh: 查询用户所有消费组列表，或按消费组名称进行模糊查询
name: QueryConsumerGroupList

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If an ID value is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no <props="intl"><ph>Overview page or </ph></props>ID value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The number of consumer groups to display per page in the response. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 1000
parameters.help_zh: 指定返回结果中每页显示的消费组数量，最小值为1，最大值为1000
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number to display in the response. Minimum value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定显示返回结果中的第几页，最小值为1
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use fuzzy query. Valid values:

true: Uses fuzzy query. You must specify the GroupName parameter.
false: Queries all consumer groups of the user.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用模糊查询。可选值：

true：使用模糊查询，需指定GroupName参数。
false：查询该用户的所有消费组。

默认为false
parameters.name: fuzzy

parameters.help_en: The consumer group name to query when fuzzy query is used. Specify this parameter when Fuzzy is set to true
parameters.help_zh: 模糊查询时要查询的消费组名称，当Fuzzy取值为true时传入
parameters.name: group_name

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

PageCount.description_en: The total number of pages in the response

PageSize.description_en: The number of consumer groups displayed per page

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful.

true: The call is successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。

true：调用成功。
false：调用失败

Total.description_en: The total number of consumer groups returned
